steps.title: The season recital
steps.body:
Twelve weeks of sittings end here. They covered warm-ups, pedalling, ear tunes, fingering plans, the metronome ladder, phrasing, duets, eyes-shut memory, and faster reading. Two pieces for the family, and one thing you teach.

1. Say the names, play both pieces, hold the last note of each, and bow.
2. Teach someone younger a short tune, four to eight notes. Show it slowly, let them try, fix one thing, let them try again.
3. The family asks one question. Answer it.

Then write the long version of the Practice log. Say which trick from this season helped the most, and which piece you would still want to play in a year.

Teaching the tune is the real test of this whole season. If you can hand it to someone else and watch them get it, you understood it, not just played it.

steps.title: Record the recital
steps.prompt: Record the recital in one take: both pieces, names said, hands in the frame. If the lesson went well, add a second clip of the tune being taught.
